items.title: Bobby Militello interviewed by Monk Rowe, Buffalo, New York, October 14, 2002
items.q: Zembo Mosque. That was the gig that we played when he first got on the band.

ctx.x: Zembo Mosque. That was the gig that we played when he first got on the band. That was the first gig. Zembo, some Mosque somewhere, and they nicknamed him that. But when I knew that I was destined to play bari forever with Maynard, I gave my notice and said I had to leave. And we left great friends too. There was no hassle there at all.
How does he keep up physically with what he does?
